out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW MINCED BEEF STORED OVER MILK CAKE AND YOGURT IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR FLAT TOP REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required: ICE MACHINE WITH ACCUMULATION OF BLACK SUBSTANCES ON INTERNAL SURFACE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CHICKEN TIKKA, CHICKEN SHARWMA, ALFREDO SAUCE PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW GROUND BEEF STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS AND PREPARED VEGETABLES IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REORGANIZE FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: KITCHENWARE AND UTENSILS WASHED AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WITHOUT SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE TO SET UP SANITIZER SOLUTION IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR SANITIZING KITCHENWARE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL DISHES ARE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED BEFORE PLACING TO AIR DRY.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. PORTIONED NOODLES AT 46F PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY IN SEALED BAGS IN 4 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE COOLED FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. ALLOW FOODS TO COOL TO 41F OR BELOW BEFORE PORTIONING AND SEALING BAGS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PREPPED CHICKEN AND CHEESE FLATBREADS AT 72F ON RACK; CHICKEN TIKA AT 46F, CHICKEN SHARMA AT 45F IN AVANTCO 3 DOOR PREP TOP; CHICKEN TIKA AT 44F, CHICKEN SHARMA AT 44F, SHREDDED CHEESE AT 44F, BEEF & CHEESE BALLS AT 44F IN 4 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER UNIT; CHICKEN TIKA AT 44F, CHICKEN SHARMA AT 44F, DICED TOMATOES AT 44F IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED, EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS FROM AVANTCO 3 DOOR PREP TOP AND 4 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER REFRIGERATORS DURING INSPECTION. FOODS FROM AVANTCO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR WERE TRANSFERRED TO FREEZER; FLAT BREADS WERE TRANSFERRED TO OTHER UNITS FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: SWEET YOGURT IN AVANTCO 3 DOOR FLAT TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS PREPARED AND HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS ARE DATE MARKED. UNUSED OR UNSOLD PORTIONS ARE TO BE DISCARDED AFTER 7 DAYS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED ON SHELVING WITH CLEAN UTENSILS OPPOSITE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS TO SHELVING OVER MOP SINK. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. FILLI CAFE (Inspection Date: 04/24/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED HOME USE SPRAY BOTTLE OF INSECTICIDE ON SHELVING ABOVE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE USE OF INSECTICIDE AND REMOVE FROM ESTABLISHMENT. PLEASE USE ONLY CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL TREATMENT SERVICES AT ESTABLISHMENT. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: PORTIONED NOODLES AT 46F PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY IN SEALED BAGS IN 4 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE USE SHALLOW PANS, SMALLER PORTIONS IN REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS TO THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS. ALLOW FOODS TO COOL TO 41F OR BELOW BEFORE PORTIONING AND SEALING BAGS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window or door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means. OBSERVED BACK KITCHEN DOOR LEFT AJAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO KEEP DOOR CLOSED WHEN NOT IN USE DURING INSPECTION. FILLI CAFE (Inspection Date: 04/24/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: CASES OF WATER, CANNED FOODS, MAYONNAISE AND OTHER FOODS STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED FOODS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN KITCHEN DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: AVANTCO 3 DOOR PREP TOP AT 43 F AND 4 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER UNIT AT 45F UNABLE TO MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. TCS FOODS HELD FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS IN UNITS WERE DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REPAIR. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no BLEACH/CHLORINE test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH/CHLORINE test kit. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: MICROWAVE, COOK LINE, REFRIGERATION UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS in the KITCHEN UNDER 3 COMPARTMENT SINK, UNDER COOK LINE, UNDER COUNTERS ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including food allergy awareness, hand washing, food temperatures (holding, cooking, reheating, cooling), thermometer calibration, proper storage of raw animal proteins, proper washing, rinsing, and sanitizing of equipment/utensils, etc as it relates to their assigned duties.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. EHS SENT THE OWNERSHIP AND STAFF FACT SHEETS TO REVIEW BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025. EHS EXPECTS STAFF TO UNDERSTAND THEIR JOB DUTIES DURING THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: Observed no certified food manager present during the majority of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS INSTRUCTED THE CURRENT PERSON IN CHARGE TO ENSURE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER IS PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. MORE STAFF SHALL BECOME CERTIFIED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, no employee health policy is in place. Ownership and staff had not reviewed the employee illness reporting agreement and acknowledged their understanding of the policy.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information emailed at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS EMAILED THE EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT TO THE OWNER/MANAGER. ALL STAFF WILL READ, UNDERSTAND, AND ACKNOWLEDGE THEIR UNDERSTANDING OF THE POLICY BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS EMAILED THE OWNER/MANAGER A COPY OF THE WRITTEN VOMITING/DIARRHEA CLEAN UP POLICY. ENSURE YOU HAVE A KIT STOCKED IN CASE OF AN EMERGENCY OF VOMITING AND/OR DIARRHEA BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025. THIS IS USUALLY A BODILY CLEAN UP KIT YOU CAN ORDER ONLINE. FILLI CAFE (Inspection Date: 10/29/2025) Page 3 of 6

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed food employees not washing their hands after removing gloves, changing tasks, and before donning clean, single use gloves.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF ON PROPER HAND WASHING TO INCLUDE WHERE, WHEN, AND HOW. ENSURE STAFF ARE FULLY TRAINED AND CONTINUED COMPLIANCE IS OBSERVED DURING THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed one kitchen hand sink fully blocked of access.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REMOVE THE STORAGE OF DRY GOODS ON DUNNAGE RACKS THAT IS DIRECTLY BLOCKING ACCESS TO THE HAND SINK. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the SERVER STATION hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS AT THE SERVER STATION HAND SINK BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025, EHS ALSO REMINDED STAFF THAT THIS SINK IS SPECIFICALLY FOR HAND WASHING AND NOT DUMPING OR WASHING DIRTY EQUIPMENT/UTENSILS. ALL EQUIPMENT/UTENSILS USED IN MAKING BEVERAGES SHALL BE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED IN THE 3-VAT SINK LOCATED IN THE KITCHEN EVERY 4 HOURS WHEN IN USE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) OBSERVED RAW, GROUND BEEF AND RAW CHICKEN STORED ON SHELVES ABOVE CHEESE AND COOKED FOODS INSIDE THE 2DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO RE-ORGANIZE THE UNIT IMMEDIATELY TO MOVE THE RAW, GROUND BEEF AND RAW CHICKEN TO THE LOWEST SHELF IN THE UNIT TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: 1) EHS OBSERVED A STAFF MEMBER WASH AND RINSE PLASTIC SQUEEZE BOTTLES AND LIDS BUT HE DID NOT SANITIZE THEM IN THE BLEACH WATER SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO WASH, RINSE, AND CHEMICALLY SANITIZE ALL EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS IN A BLEACH WATER SOLUTION AT A CONCENTRATION OF 50-200PPM FOR 10 SECONDS BEFORE AIR DRYING. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) OBSERVED CHICKEN TENDERS AT 101F-114F IN THE FRYER BASKET, 2) OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY PROCESSED SAMOSAS AT 114F-125F UNDER THE HEAT LAMP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REHEAT THE FOODS TO 165F OR DISCARD THEM. ENSURE HOT FOODS ARE HELD AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES TO PREVENT BACTERIAL GROWTH. STAFF MEMBER DISCARDED SOME FOODS AND REHEATED OTHERS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed raw shelled eggs and pooled eggs stored at room temperature. Eggs were measured at 52f-74f.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISCARD THE EGGS. ENSURE EGGS ARE RECEIVED AT 45F OR BELOW AND THEN ARE MAINTAINED AT 45F OR BELOW DURING STORAGE. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025. FILLI CAFE (Inspection Date: 10/29/2025) Page 2 of 6

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) FOODS JUST SITTING OUT ON COUNTERS: A) CUT LETTUCE AND SLICED TOMATOES: 68F, B) GARLIC MAYONNAISE: 67F, C) MINT AND GARLIC MAYONNAISE: 68F, F) FLAT BREAD PIZZAS WITH COOKED/DICED CHICKEN: 63F-69F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCARD THE FOODS IF EXPOSED TO TEMPERATURE ABUSE FOR MORE THAN 3 HOURS. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO MOVE PREPARED FOODS INTO A WORKING REFRIGERATOR IF PREPARED WITHIN THE LAST HOUR. ENSURE FOODS ARE PREPARED AND IMMEDIATELY STORED UNDER REFRIGERATION. ENSURE COLD FOODS REMAIN AT 41F OR BELOW UNLESS IN A PHASE OF COOLING. IF COOLING, THE FOODS SHALL BE COOLED EFFECTIVELY AND RAPIDLY. SEE FACT SHEETS ON PROPER HOLDING TEMPERATURES AND COOLING TEMPERATURES. ENSURE TRAINING AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: 1) OPENED PACKAGES OF CHEESE, 2) OPENED AND PREPARED COMMERCIAL PANEER, 3) OPENED CANNED GOODS LIKE CHICK PEAS, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL AND DATE ALL OPENED PACKAGES, CANS, ETC OF COMMERCIALLY PROCESSED FOODS IF STORED UNDER REFRIGERATION FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS. SEE FACT SHEET ON DATE MARKING AND ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) HOME MADE SAUCES TO INCLUDE: A) GARLIC MAYONNAISE, B) MINT AND GARLIC MAYONNAISE, C) SWEET YOGURT, D) COOKED FOODS LIKE CHICKEN, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT ANY PREPARED FOODS SITTING UNDER REFRIGERATION FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS SHALL BE LABELED AND DATE MARKED. SEE FACT SHEET ON DATE MARKING AND ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold equipment: 1) AVANTCO 3DOOR PREP TOP REFRIGERATOR IN THE KITCHEN (FOR STORAGE OF FLAT BREAD PIZZAS, WHOLE MILK YOGURT, ETC).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF TO ENSURE ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS ARE DESIGNED OR EQUIPPED WITH VISIBLE, WORKING, AND ACCURATE THERMOMETERS THAT MEASURE THE AMBIENT AIR TEMPERATURE OF THE UNITS AT 34F-38F TO KEEP FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING CONTAINERS OF SEASONINGS, 2) SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SAUCES, 3) SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF CONDIMENTS AT THE DRINK STATION, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PROPERLY LABEL ALL WORKING CONTAINERS, BULK BINS, AND BOTTLES BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed drain flies in the kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO CONTACT A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR TO PERFORM ROUTINE INSPECTIONS OF THE FACILITY AND PROVIDE TREATMENT AS NEEDED TO REMOVE ANY DRAIN AND/OR FRUIT FLIES AND HOUSE FLIES (AS NEEDED). ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Observed an electrocuting type insect control device located in the kitchen directly next to the food prep sink and work table.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REMOVE THE INSECT CONTROL DEVICE AND RE-LOCATE IT TO AN AREA ABOVE THE REAR KITCHEN DOOR OR ANYWHERE NOT NEAR OR ABOVE FOOD PREPARATION AREAS. DEVICE WAS REMOVED DURING THE INSPECTION. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025. FILLI CAFE (Inspection Date: 10/29/2025) Page 5 of 6

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Observed the rear kitchen door wide open and flies in the kitchen areas.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO CLOSE THE REAR KITCHEN DOOR. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION FOR THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food, canned goods, syrups, bottled water, canned beverages, etc stored directly on the floor in the kitchen and hallway leading to the restrooms.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO GET ALL FOOD ITEMS OFF THE FLOOR AND PROPERLY STORED ON NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT ONLY A FLAT WEDDING BAND IS ALLOWED. NO WATCHES, APPLE WATCHES, BRACELETS, ETC. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION FOR THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT EVERYONE PREPARING FOOD AND BEVERAGES SHALL WEAR HATS OR HAIR NETS AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) OBSERVED THE ICE SCOOP LYING INSIDE THE ICE MACHINE AT THE SERVER STATION.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO STORE THE ICE SCOOP HANDLE SIDE UP, OUT OF THE ICE. IT SHALL BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED EVERY 24 HOURS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed staff “wet nesting” cleaned and sanitized equipment on shelves above the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT ALL EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS THAT CONTACT FOOD SHALL BE WASHED, RINSED ,CHEMICALLY SANITIZED AND THEN AIR DRIED BEFORE BEING STACKED ON TOP OF EACH OTHER. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed pizza boxes and other single service items directly stored on the floor in the kitchen and server areas.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT NOTHING SHALL BE DIRECTLY STORED ON THE FLOOR. ENSURE STORAGE ON NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Handled Single-Service/Use Items Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored with the handles up at the server station.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO WASH HIS HANDS, PUT ON GLOVES, AND ORGANIZE THE UTENSILS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions used at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF AND SHOWED THE OWNER THE PROPER TEST STRIPS FOR CHLORINE (BLEACH). PROVIDE THE TEST STRIPS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025. CHLORINE IS A VALID SANITIZER IF MAINTAINED IN A SOLUTION AT 50-200PPM.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) INTERIORS OF REFRIGERATION UNITS INCLUDING FLOORS, 2) INTERIOR OF THE MICROWAVE OVEN.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PERFORM DAILY CLEANING TO REMOVE FOOD DEBRIS AND RESIDUE. ENSURE CLEANING IS DONE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3-VAT SINK are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REPAIR THE LEAKS AT THE 3-VAT SINK BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the kitchen floor not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REPAIR THE DAMAGED FLOORING IN THE KITCHEN BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION IN APPROXIMATELY 6 MONTHS. FILLI CAFE (Inspection Date: 10/29/2025) Page 4 of 6

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT AFTER USING MOPS, THEY SHALL BE CLEANED AND HUNG TO ALLOW AIR DRYING. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 11/7/2025.

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed the ceiling panels in the restrooms not smooth, easily cleanable, washable, and non-absorbent.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO REPLACE THE RESTROOM CEILING PANELS WITH VINYL COATED CEILING TILES WHEN THEY BECOME DAMAGED IN ANY WAY (E.G. HOLES, GAPS, WATER LEAKS, STAINS, ETC).
